svg.title: Billing hierarchies: Enterprise Agreement and Microsoft customer agreement
svg.desc: Two panels, following two diagrams in the official documentation. Top, Enterprise Agreement: a Microsoft Entra tenant on top, then the Azure RBAC tree of management groups, subscriptions, resource groups and resources. Beside it, the EA roles: Azure EA enrollment, EA department (optional) and EA account owner, with the roles Enterprise Administrator, Department Administrator and Account Owner. The EA account owner gets the Azure RBAC Owner role on its subscriptions, shown by dashed arrows. Bottom, Microsoft customer agreement: a billing account holds a billing profile, which has an invoice and payment methods; the billing profile holds invoice sections; each invoice section holds subscriptions. Cloud Solution Provider has no diagram in the official documentation and is not drawn. Icons are official Azure and Microsoft Entra icons.
svg.text: Billing hierarchies: Enterprise Agreement and Microsoft customer agreement
EA roles give no subscription access,
Cloud Solution Provider (CSP) has no diagram in the official documentation.
